name: Coal Residue AP OLD
description: Combustible material can ignite and burn ferociously.
disable: mining-lore|dc:15 (trained) to spread inert material over the area or DC 18 Survival to pry up enough of the material to prevent a chain reaction.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ignite
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An effect in the area deals at least 8 Electricity Damage or 4 Fire Damage

Effect The coal residue rapidly ignites, dealing 4d6 Fire Damage damage to all creatures in the area (Basic DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save). The area burns for 1 minute, during which creatures in the area are Concealed, other creatures are concealed to them, and creatures who end their turn in the area take 1d6 Fire Damage damage.
